svg.text: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for models, one MCP endpoint for tools, Prometheus + Grafana watching both.
Routes by model name, then least-loaded,
ties to the worker with the warm prefix
q8 KV · 32 GB host prompt cache
RX 6700 XT · ROCm · 1 slot x 32k · 94 tok/s
Alerts: GPU hotspot and memory (both cards + Jetson), fan stalled, CPU / VRM heat,
disk under 10%, worker or exporter down, Jetson memory, sensor script stalled.
Dashboard rows: pool · agent tools · energy and cost · health (server, desktop, Jetson)
